site.name: Sewa Track
home.title: Where are ward requests delayed?
home.subtitle: Apply for ward recommendation letters, track them with a code, and see where requests are overdue against the citizen charter, across all 753 local levels.
home.demoData: Demo data, generated for this portfolio project.
home.step1: Check the documents and the demo fee for your letter.
home.step2: Apply online and keep your tracking code.
home.step3: Follow every step without visiting the office.
home.mostOverdue: Districts with the most overdue requests
home.mapSoon: The interactive district map is added once a boundary file that follows Nepal's official 2020 map is verified.

services.intro: Know the documents, fee and promised time before you visit.

footer.about: Sewa Track is an open-source demo of a national ward service tracker.
track.title: Track your request
track.intro: Enter the tracking code you received when you applied. No login needed.
track.label: Tracking code
track.hint: Letters O, I and L are read as 0 and 1.
track.invalid: The code should look like ST-7K3QX9M2PD.
track.notFound: No request found with this code. Check it and try again.
track.tooMany: Too many lookups. Please wait a minute and try again.
track.privacy: Shown publicly: status and dates only. No names, IDs or notes.
login.title: Log in
login.demoIntro: One click, fake accounts only. There is no sign-up: this demo never collects real phone numbers.
